name: @cosmosapp/pay_sdk
description: Official SDK for Cosmos Pay, the stablecoin payments API for Stellar, Solana and Monad: payment intents and checkout, webhooks, swaps (same-chain and cross-chain), fiat ramps, products and customers. Payment links on all three (SEP-7, Solana Pay, EIP-681). Includes a browser client for Stellar wallets.
author: Cosmos Pay
